evidence: Resolved part: pick_up_local_facts admits by the `admitted` set from load_facts, which honors local receipts and the historical rule. refold also uses load_facts.

live_pickup_preserves_receipted_revocation_after_role_change uses the real standalone author_fact(team=None) connection_disabled, then a received member.set_role demotion, then pickup. The fact is retained and the receipt survives.
Remaining gap (TOCTOU): load_facts acquires and releases the state lock internally. pick_up_local_facts then calls read_lines with no lock held and scans the result.

Suppose another process, such as the admin CLI's author_fact(team=None), appends a receipted, authorized line after load_facts returns and before or during the scan. That line is absent from `admitted` and from env.fact_hashes.
quarantine_local_fact then takes the lock, re-reads the file, removes the identical line from facts.jsonl and records it in rejected_facts.jsonl.

Result: an irreversible revocation or removal the CLI already applied and reported is silently deleted. Serve's next refold re-derives the connection as active. The deletion is not audited and does not appear in status. It is lost permanently on this node, because the CLI path never broadcasts.
Receive-thread and publish paths are protected, because store_fact inserts into fact_hashes under the same lock as the append.
resolution_conditions: Hold the state lock across load_facts, the line scan and quarantine in pick_up_local_facts. Alternatively, never quarantine a line missing from a stale `admitted` snapshot: re-run admission for it under the lock, or defer it to the next poll.
Add a test that appends a receipted author_fact(team=None) line after the admission snapshot is taken and before the scan. Assert the line is retained and the connection stays disabled.

new_findings.title: Every 50 ms poll runs the full cold fact-admission load while holding the exclusive state lock
evidence: pick_up_local_facts unconditionally calls load_facts for every environment with any facts, on every poll tick (about 50 ms).

Each call, under the exclusive state lock (flock shared with the CLI and all state writers): reads facts.jsonl and both receipt stores, folds all commits for the identity document, and runs about three Ed25519 verifications per line (needs_history receipt check, fact signature, receipt).

Facts are monotone and never compacted, so cost grows linearly without bound. With a few hundred to a thousand facts, a single pass approaches or exceeds the poll interval. The state lock is then held most of the time, delaying admin CLI and other local transactions.
This repeats the pattern N3 removed from the repair path. refold also runs load_facts, but only when there is actual change.
resolution_conditions: Skip the scan when facts.jsonl is unchanged since the last pickup (length, mtime or known_fact_lines), or evaluate only lines not already in fact_hashes, verifying each new line at most once.
Cache the identity fold by store vector, as relaxed_document already does.
Optionally add a test or benchmark asserting that an idle poll with N facts performs no signature verification or fold.

non_findings_checked: Lock order is consistent: the state lock is always taken before the envs mutex. admit_member, author_commit, submit_commit and refold take the state lock re-entrantly within one thread, per the supplied store.rs.
flush_deferred_sends uses mem::take and then sends outside both the state lock and the envs mutex. A send failure drops only that session.
Peer-received and published facts write a receipt before the append and insert into fact_hashes under the same lock, so the NEW-6 race does not apply to them.
load_facts identity and authority folds use all_commits without a snapshot. Compaction never deletes env.init, membership, ownership or dek.rotate commits, so the folds stay correct after compaction.
Removal notices are deferred with the full fact dict, and flush rebuilds them with Fact::from_dict, so target and exclusion are preserved.
The admission audit records env_id and fingerprint only, with no invite material.
limitations: Static review only. Nothing was built or executed, and file SHA-256 values were not checked against the head.
